title: Impact of Algae Blooms and Oil Spills on Aim to Increase Locally Farmed Fish in Local Consumption
what_it_is: Impact of Algae Blooms and Oil Spills on Aim to Increase Locally Farmed Fish in Local Consumption

sections.label: Local fish production targets
sections.summary: Algae blooms and an oil spill did not stop the push for 15% local fish production, which rose from 8% in 2014 to 10% in 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for National Development (a) what impact did algae blooms and the recent oil spill have on AVA's target for locally farmed fish to comprise 15% of local fish consumption; (b) what measures are taken to help coastal fish farmers cope with the aftermath of these events; and (c) what measures are taken to help fish farmers change their production methods so that they are more efficient and less susceptible to algae blooms and oil spills.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: However, these events have not detracted from our push to achieve 15% local production.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Local fish production increased from 4,205 tonnes in 2014 or 8% of local consumption, to 4,851 tonnes in 2016 or 10% of local consumption.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Having said that, I would add that the Agri-Food and Veterinary Authority (AVA) is currently reviewing the longer-term targets for local food production and working with industry and various stakeholders to develop concepts towards transforming the local farming industry.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: After the plankton blooms in 2014 and 2015, AVA extended subsidies to help affected farms to restock their fish.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: AVA is now assisting affected farmers with their claims against the ship's insurers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: First, AVA has developed a real-time online water quality monitoring system that our farmers can access through their mobile phones.

sections.label: AVA farm contingency and technology support
sections.summary: Almost 50 farms developed contingency plans with AVA, which co-funded new farming technologies like closed containment aquaculture systems.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To date, almost 50 farms have worked with AVA to develop customised contingency plans to mitigate adverse conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Third, AVA has used the Co-Innovation Partnership Programme to co-fund the development and adoption of new farming technologies like closed containment aquaculture systems.
